sin.description: A query's first() falls back to a throw through ?? instead of saying so in the query.
sin.name: first-or-throw
sin.rule: A query that throws when it finds no row says so in the query: ->firstOr(fn () => throw TaskMissing::forId($id)), or ->firstOrFail() when Laravel's own exception is wanted; never ->first() ?? throw (rule 49).
